# towxml-stream-typewriter

- Upstream: https://github.com/zhouzxx/towxml-stream-typewriter
- Version: `1.0.3`
- Commit: `5b64114d01b58638758009b7cab819f5c391a923`
- License: MIT (`LICENSE.txt`)

Local compatibility changes are intentionally limited to:

1. replacing deprecated Mini Program `selectable` with `user-select`;
2. disabling unused remote LaTeX/YUML service URLs so this component never introduces a third-party network dependency.
